notes: SHIP v1.14.382 - COMMAND SHELL PHASE 1, BEHIND ?cshell=1. Implements spec 6.3, 6.4 and 8.1-8.7 of PHANTOM_RESPONSIVE_COMMAND_SHELL_SPEC.md under a NEW shell root, body.rd.cshell. THE BARE URL IS BYTE-IDENTICAL TO .381 AND SO IS ?legacy=1: every rule that paints is body.rd.cshell-scoped, the markup is display:none by default, and the class is added only when ?cshell=1 is in the query string. THE FLAG IS DELIBERATELY NOT PERSISTED. redesign_isOn() writes phantom_legacy to localStorage because ?legacy=1 is a rip-cord that must survive a reload; cshell_isOn() reads location.search only. A sticky preview flag is exactly the trap .380 had to ship a way out of, and this ship does not recreate it - close the tab and the shell is gone. WHAT LANDED: (1) 6.3 shell root with a background bloom of two faint radials plus a technical grid at 0.022 alpha on a 48px pitch. background-attachment:fixed from the spec was dropped - it is broken on iOS Safari and this is an iOS PWA - and the page black is var(--bg0) rather than the spec's #020305 because the colour mapping resolved --phantom-page as do-not-add and a second competing near-black is the drift that ruling prevents. The two are visually indistinguishable. (2) 6.4 smoked-slate glass card material as .cs-card, shell-scoped, with the live --rd-cardfill recipe still authoritative everywhere else. NO !important, and that is verified rather than assumed: the plan called it required to beat the .310 SURFACE-GLOW block, but that block forces fills on a NAMED selector list (.nba/.stat/.tile/.spill/.gx*) and a sweep of every !important background and border rule in the file found zero whose selector can reach a brand-new class. Confirmed in-browser. (3) 8.1/8.2/8.4/8.5/8.6 phone frame, header and secure microbar at the spec's exact values - 14px side padding, 118px bottom clearance, 16px section gap, 35x35 brand mark, 17px brand text, 33px/12px site pill, 9px microbar. (4) 8.7 Active Deployment hero at 343px min-height, 26px radius, 20px/18px/17px padding, 30px title, 72% progress block, three-column KPI row, 49px cyan-to-violet action. THREE PLAN CORRECTIONS MADE DURING THE BUILD, EACH VERIFIED FIRST: the brand mark is phantom-prism.png, not phantom-shield-256.webp - the plan named the overflow-menu button glyph, whose own inline comment reads 'site-node art; filename is legacy (was shield)'. phantom-prism.png is existing approved art, already in PRECACHE_URLS, referenced by nothing until now, and is the header mark the redesign campaign already earmarked. It is painted as a CSS background rather than an so a display:none shell never fetches it - the same dead-weight class the .381 cleanup purged. The microbar text is var(--slate), not var(--slate-dim), whose own :root comment reserves it for borders and decoration and says NEVER text. And the site-health dot is not hardcoded healthy: cmd_setSiteLabel already has two states and can render SET UP PROFILE, so a mint dot over that text would be a lie the aisle cannot see through - confirmed profile is var(--ok) mint, unconfirmed is var(--gold) attention. NO FAKE DATA ANYWHERE. The hero renders from the honest values cmd_render already computes for the NBA and the telemetry tiles - activeDep, activePct, rackCount, blockerCount - and introduces no new data source. Values are written with textContent rather than interpolated into innerHTML, so a deployment name can never become markup. With no active deployment the progress bar is REMOVED rather than shown at 0%, because a zero bar reads as started-and-stalled. The microbar's right slot carries the real wall clock from the existing cmd_clock tick; the spec mock's 'Shift 01' was not reproduced because there is no shift-number concept in this app and inventing one would be fake telemetry (the real shift feature, SHIFT_END_KEY / shift_renderHero, is a countdown that is honest about being unset, and Phase 2 re-homes it here). The CTA reuses cmd_route('work','deploy'), the same door the NBA's continue-deployment action uses - one door per feature. cmd_setSiteLabel was restructured to feed both the legacy #rd-site and the shell's #cs-site from ONE source instead of returning early on a missing element, and now warns when the site source itself is absent. COLOUR: every value binds to the live channel map, never the spec's parallel --phantom-* hexes. Healthy is var(--ok), attention is var(--gold), active is var(--cyan), intelligence is var(--violet), and the blockers KPI uses the fault LITERAL #ff2bd6 matching all 40 live fault sites and the cc-magstrip precedent - never var(--mag), which is #boot-scoped with zero consumers and silently invalidates any declaration that uses it. NOT TOUCHED: the .cc-z0 status band is hidden under the shell only, since the new header and microbar replace it. The shared .app-header stays visible on purpose for this phase - it carries the version badge, the SW pill and the net pill, which are the instruments the device verify reads; Phase 2 re-homes them. Nothing outside #pg-cmd was modified. No precache entry changed. DEVICE-VERIFY: (1) badge reads v1.14.382. (2) BARE URL FIRST - the app must be visually identical to .381 on every page. This is the most important check; if anything moved, the scoping leaked. (3) ?legacy=1 unchanged, and the RETURN TO NEW UI item still works. (4) NOW ADD ?cshell=1 to the Command page - you should see the prism brand mark, PHANTOM / Field Intelligence System, the site pill on the right, the lock microbar, and the deployment hero. The old site/status band should be gone; the top app header stays. (5) THE ONE THING THAT NEEDS YOUR EYES IS THE HERO CROP - the art is 1170x403 and the hero is roughly square, so cover shows about a third of its width anchored at 78%. If the crop lands badly, that is a background-position tune, not a revert, and no recut is needed. (6) Check the title and eyebrow stay readable over the busiest part of the art; if not, the scrim's first stop deepens - the artwork does not move. (7) With no deployment captured, the hero must read 'No active deployment' / 'Nothing deploying yet' with NO progress bar and a START A DEPLOYMENT button. (8) If your site profile is not confirmed, the site pill dot must be GOLD, not mint, and read SET UP PROFILE. (9) Zero horizontal overflow at 390 and 430. (10) Reload with ?cshell=1 removed - the shell must vanish, proving the flag did not stick. ROLLBACK: revert this commit range; the shell is additive and nothing existing was rewritten except cmd_setSiteLabel, which is a strict superset of its old behaviour. STILL OPEN: the #6c2bd6 fault value from the 2026-08-05 ruling appears nowhere in the app while #ff2bd6 has 40 sites; treated as a typo and left untouched, and Phase 2's Intelligence card needs it resolved. PHASE 2 is spec 8.8-8.12 - Intelligence card, build rail, field ops, tools, shift readiness, bottom nav and scanner sheet. PHASE 3 is spec 9 desktop, still blocked on the missing reference files named in the plan.
